title: 第23章 等着下辈子再跟你斗第24章 我不吃香菜

lines: 老壮士饶命啊！
【“不说实话，我今天就把你千刀万剐，让你尝遍皮肉之苦！
再杀你全家！”
【“我说！
我说！
那个陈奕是个误会，本来火旺村的案子就是想丢给沈青山的，没想到被陈奕撞上了！
后来我爹又筹划了一下，沈青山终于上套了！
一直算计他，是因为沈青山在查衙门的一些案子！”
【“什么案子？”
【“一些县里的……命案，这些命案其实都结案了……但，凶手都是被冤枉的，真凶都是……是……妖！”
【四周的官差无不震惊。
【“把妖杀人的案子冤枉给人？为什么？？”
【“县太爷就是再贪污，他也是个人啊，为什么要帮妖？？”
【“县太爷图什么？”
【官差们的疑问也是你疑惑的点。
【瘦县令四处看看，长叹一口气，知道自己今天不说，也是个死。
【就在他准备全部吐露出来的时候。
的一声，衙门大门轰然关闭。
【众人转头看去，却见穿着一身黑底金纹官服的斩妖司主司封于成来了。
【看到封于成，瘦县令十分惊恐。
【“我，我让你们去护龙司找人帮忙，谁让你们去斩妖司的？！”

【“Ah!
Old man, spare your life!
! "
["If you don't tell the truth, I will cut you into pieces today and let you taste the pain of your skin and flesh!"
Kill your whole family again! "
["I said!
I say!
That Chen Yi was a misunderstanding. Originally, he wanted to throw the Huowang Village case to Shen Qingshan, but he didn't expect to be bumped into by Chen Yi!
Later, my father made some more plans, and Shen Qingshan finally fell into the trap!
She has been plotting against him because Shen Qingshan is investigating some cases in the Yamen! "
["What case?"
["Some... murder cases in the county, these murder cases have actually been closed... However, the murderers were all wrongly accused, and the real culprits are all... demons!"
[The officials around him were all shocked.
["Unjustly accusing people of demon-murder cases? Why??"
["No matter how corrupt the county magistrate is, he is still a human being. Why should he help the demon??"
["What does the county magistrate want?"
[The questions of the officials are also what make you confused.
[The Thin County Magistrate looked around and let out a long sigh, knowing that if he didn't say anything today, he would be dead.
[Just when he was about to reveal everything.
【"Bang"
With a sound, the yamen door slammed shut.
[Everyone turned around and saw Feng Yucheng, the head of the Demon Slaying Department, wearing a black official uniform with gold patterns, arriving.
[Seeing Feng Yucheng, the thin county magistrate was very frightened.
["I, I asked you to go to the Dragon Protection Division to find help. Who asked you to go to the Demon Slayer Division?!"
